assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: panoramic website hero background. Create a beautiful realistic aerial view of a modern Chinese grain port linking northern grain production with southern distribution. Wide landscape 3:1 composition. Right half contains a large bulk cargo vessel at quay, ivory grain silos, teal-blue gantry cranes, parallel rail tracks with a grain freight train and a small grain truck, amber grain and vegetation accents, believable scale. Deep ocean teal water and softly hazy industrial horizon. Left 45% is quiet deep teal water and haze with very few details, intentionally suitable for white website headline overlay. Rich yet restrained cinematic early morning daylight, attractive precision and atmosphere, professional transport photography. No typography, labels, lettering, watermarks, logos, digital dashboards, dotted circles or neon networks. Infrastructure concentrated on right half and middle-right.
